title: Vesper and the Spire Anew
premise: Petra Marchetti, a mercenary bound by oath to a god who has gone silent, keeps the ledgers of the Vesper Guild, which trades in impossible things — stolen names, bottled weather, second chances. When the border wards collapse and the stars go out in a single night, their country is erased from every map and memory but its own, and Petra's ledger becomes the only record that anyone ever lived there. Guided by the found family of the guild and hunted by the empire rewriting them out of existence, they must find the Spire Anew, the last door standing outside time. In the end, Petra pays the price of survival by surrendering their own name to the door, letting the guild carry everyone else through — and discovering that a name given freely, unlike one taken, can be written back.
about_author: Ada Nakamura is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing guild records from collapsed trade cities before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about bureaucracy as magic and magic as debt, and live somewhere with very long winters.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: POV: Petra Marchetti. During an ordinary audit night at the Vesper Guild, the border wards shatter and every star vanishes; the country's name dissolves from maps, letters, even memories outside its borders. Petra's ledgers alone still hold the truth. The emotional beat is vertigo and stubborn denial — Petra refuses to accept erasure and rallies the guild around the only proof left: ink on paper.

chapters.title: Debts Owed to No One
chapters.summary: POV: alternating between Petra and Sefa, the guild's youngest runner whose family has forgotten her face. The guild liquidates its impossible inventory to fund an expedition to the Spire Anew, while imperial wardens arrive to confiscate 'unregistered persons.' The beat is found family hardening into resolve — each member chooses the guild over safety, and Petra breaks their silent god's altar to pay for passage.

chapters.title: What the Door Demands
chapters.summary: POV: Petra. Crossing a winter-locked countryside where erased people fade like frost, the guild reaches the Spire Anew and learns its price: one true name per soul, freely surrendered. Wardens close in, led by Petra's old commander, who offers amnesty for betrayal. The climax strikes here — Petra gives up their own name instead, holding the door open as the guild passes through, unmaking themselves mid-sentence.

chapters.title: Written Back
chapters.summary: POV: Sefa, then Petra. On the far side, the guild discovers Petra's sacrifice left a blank page in the ledger — and a blank page can be refilled. Trading away everything they own, they write Petra's name back with ink mixed from the fallen stars. The resolution lands on justice outside the law: no empire, no god, just family keeping accounts, and a new guild founded beyond the border with Petra's hand steady on the pen.
